result.title: Only Means Only: what a harmonization benchmark score averages over
result.comment: 18 pages including references, 3 figures in the paper and 1 in the supplement. The supplement is included as an ancillary file and published with the preprint record, DOI 10.5281/zenodo.23404530
result.summary: Image harmonization methods adjust the colour and lighting of an object pasted into a photograph so that it looks native to its new scene, and they are ranked by average error on one benchmark whose test images are real photographs with one object recoloured. One photograph can yield several such test images, and the benchmark promises that no photograph appears in both the training and the test split. We find that 1,399 photographs do, and the composites built on them are a quarter of the test set. Duplicate checks over file names or bytes miss this, because every composite is a different file. On that quarter the three methods we score end to end read two to five times lower error than on the rest, but most of the gap is composition rather than the sharing: the shared composites come almost entirely from one of the benchmark's four source collections, and inside that collection the gap falls to about one and a half times. An official score is therefore an average over two populations, mixed in a proportion the benchmark does not report. We release a test list of 5,581 composites whose construction identities do not appear in training, with four confirmed near-duplicate pairs disclosed rather than removed, adoptable without retraining at the price of one rescore per checkpoint. We leave open whether the sharing itself changes what a model learns.

AI.brief_summary: 该论文审计图像和谐化基准的划分泄漏：发现 1,399 张照片同时出现在训练与测试划分，构成约四分之一测试复合图，并指出官方分数实际混合了两种分布，随后发布一份 5,581 条无构造身份重叠的测试清单。
AI.relevance_reason: 图像和谐化属低层图像编辑任务，不涉及多模态推理的内部状态、视觉证据筛选或停止决策，其分数有效性与数据重叠审计与 LVR 主线无实质联系，也未见可迁移到 latent 推理的方法线索，故排除。
